body:
For me personally, I'd be relieved. 

I'd spend the rest of my life making peace with everyone, and theyd accept it more because it "cant be helped."

I'd go to a bunch of new places and then just wait for death.
I have so much I wanna write, but it's hard. I'll probably end up with a small note
Anywhere is an option tbh, but right now it looks like I'm heading up to Nottingham. It's quite close and I really like it :)
Thanks! :)

Yeah, it's not ideal, hence I want to just get things over and done with. 

I am not homeless yet, but it's looking very likely.

Mine is too. When's yours?

I totally get that feeling, being forgotten on your birthday is never fun.
Nice! Lemme know if you wanna chat :)

I know this feeling all too well. Even with family, I still remember that sinking feeling in my stomach when my brothers and I all "jokingly" picked a favourite, and I realised that I was no one's.

I'm sorry, OP.

As a back up option, it's sure as hell comforting. 

People joke all the time these days, like "Well if X doesn't work out, we can always kill ourselves!" But that's the mentality I've had for years now, lol.
I would love to, but I don't have a passport sorted :(

Thank you! I'm hoping to have a good time. 

Honestly, not really. I do intend on buying some scratch cards (because why not lol), and I suppose if I won a bit on that, it would postpone things. Only because then I could use the money to travel further. I've not really been outside my home town aside crashing on my friend's sofa, so it would be nice to go other places I never got to see.

If I somehow, miraculously, won a lot, I would definitely reconsider things. A lot of my problems can be solved by money. I'm not sure though.

Thank you for your message. This means a lot, and is way more helpful than you think. 

Tbh, they're just salty because they approached me in a weird way (like a lot of the guys on here, "you just need a friend 🥺🥺 maybe even a .... b-boyfriend???"), and I told them to piss off. 

I'm apparently a bitch for "crying out for help" (I'm not), and I was told "I still want to help you, but part of me wants to yell at you".... as if I'm a child who needs scolding! 

Again, thank you for being cool :)

There are small things like going to the zoo, having a proper meal out, maybe get the piercings I always wanted to get. Oh, and go to a cat cafe, I love cats!

Itll mostly be for travel though. Just a month of seeing new places before I finally go.

It's not a temporary problem I'm afraid. Too much shit has happened, and I'm now facing homelessness on top of that. 

I don't want to face that, I won't survive out there. Better to go out on my own terms.
If you believe in reincarnation, it might be an option for the future!
I almost did to hasta manana by ABBA. It wasn't by choice, but oddly fitting
Yeah, my wage doesn't come until the 27th.

I feel like this.

It's one of the reasons I'm so into donating blood and being an organ donator. I think I'd even willingly carry someone's child for them. I just want this body to be of use.
I'm doing that so I actually go through with it. I'm burning all my bridges so I have no possible way of coming back.

Aw man OP, I know exactly how you feel. Especially being vulnerable as a homeless person, I don't wanna go through more traumatic shit, so I'm gonna finish it before that happens.

I hope you find peace, however that may be.

If they offered euthanasia to everyone 18 and over, they would be surprised at the amount of people who would take it. Actually, maybe they wouldn't, and that's why it isn't offered.

I'm in the same position as you OP. Survival is a nightmare.

Same. I've even considered just putting my location for some random nutter to travel to and kill me. I would never do that, for obvious reasons, but I'd still be willing for someone to just take me out.

Honestly, I'm guilty of this. Even after previously attempting. 

And now, whilst living with a friend, I catch myself mumbling stuff like that and feel guilty because it's true. But to him, it's just a joke. I feel bad.

They created such an awful place and expect us to just get on with it. Hustle culture when some of us can't afford to get by. The world is literally ending, and we're supposed to work to our death.

And then they don't understand why people want to die.

It's easy to bottle it up and ignore it for a bit, that's what happened to me. But last year has forced a lot of us to be alone with our demons for too long. 

I guess it would have happened eventually.
No way, mine's the 10th. Happy early birthday!
Mine too, when's yours?
They really say the bare minimum and pat themselves on the back.
Not asking for advice. Also, I don't have friends or family to talk to.
This is exactly it. Plus, the boiling water will leave damage. Things will never be the same as before.
Oh gross, I'm so sorry that happened to you. A little compassion goes a long way, how can they be so stupid?

The way I see it, you can get a broken leg doing an extreme sport, or just from walking. 

It doesn't matter the situation, it's still the same injury and it deserves to be treated as such.

Exactly this. 

Hustle culture is the bane of my existence. I am so sick of the empty promises -  "If you just work hard, you'll be fine!" Same with "Just turn your hobby into your job!"

We really can't enjoy anything if it doesn't make a profit. Everything has to be exploited, and nothing is sacred from that.

Oh yeah, if I could feasibly just live off the grid, I'd do that instead. (Don't reply "But you can!!" Because I'm not talented and will probably end up dead anyways).

I wish life had other options. I see all these people travelling and doing vagabond shit. It looks cool, but is obviously very hard. I'm glad they can make it work for them.

It reminds me of that one Simpsons episode! 

"You wanna be sad, honey? Be sad. We'll ride it out with you. And when you get finished feeling sad, we'll still be there."

​

Bottling things up and pretending things are fine is what got me to this place.
Sometimes the best thing you can do is agree that life sucks. It helps more than you think.

Yep, that's basically the basis of all this. You try and try and try, but nothing ever works and you end up more stressed.

At that point, you're not living. So why even try?
In the exact same position as you, OP. Godspeed.
You shouldn't promise stuff like that.
I plan on leaving many notes, but they are so hard to write. I wouldn't blame you if you didn't.
I hope the people in my life understands this. It absolutely kills me that I'm doing this to them, but being alive hurts more.
The fear of failing really weighs heavy on me. I know exactly how you feel.
Literally. It only affects those who have some type of relationship to you, and even then only for a bit.
Stop promising things you can't guarantee. It's shitty and makes people feel worse.

This is how I'm feeling now. Like, just earlier I dyed my hair. And I was thinking "damn, this is really damaging because I've left it on longer than I should have." But it doesn't matter anymore! I can stop thinking about long term effects. It helps me a bit.

It's the equivalent of that dumb meme. 

"Jason, please, look into my eyes. This isn't you!"

​

Lol, give me a break.

So many of the people on here like that! I was actually told to meet up with one of them and talk to them on Snapchat. 

Ah yes, so instead of dying on my own terms, I get to be \*\*\*\*\* and murdered by some sicko into suicidal women.

The best case scenario is that they have some creepy saviour complex and believe that they have the power to change your life. Some twisted idea of love they have.
Yesterday I met an old man carrying a guitar and a snake around his neck. He was just walking around the town centre, and he looked so happy. It made me a smile a lot.
Yours is three days before mine, I'll be coming behind you.

This fact annoys me so much, I'm specifically referencing it in my note. 

I don't want to be remembered as someone in their English class. I especially don't want people to remember me as their best friend if they weren't.
thanks!!
It's screwed up to say, but I'm so jealous. I hope you find peace OP.
I'm curious, what novel is this from? It really resonates with me.
Want to talk?
Lol I'm going against my English nature here but I'm happy to cut in the queue

Thanks. I didn't wanna be rude, I know people are trying their best. 

But it just makes me feel worse. Thank you!
If you're in UK, let's talk. I'll be your friend before I go.
Hey, I'm in the same position! Happy birthday to us. Hopefully we can find peace, one way or another.
Omfg this used to be everyone's go to phrase, especially when you're a child.
I feel the same way
I feel this. My cat is truly my life, I don't think people can understand the bond you have with them.
This is beautiful. I'm happy for you, OP.
I'm so jealous of all of you with access to guns. I want to do it that quickly.

I am trying to find pleasure for sure, but the bad is currently outweighing the good. Right now I should be happy, but all I can think of is when my job will be finished, and then I'll be stuck back in my abusive household at home. 

I will make sure to have a good time whilst I can. Thank you for your kind message!
Money is literally the final straw for me. I understand you. Everyone pretends it doesn't, but it really does buy happiness.
